error[ZC-E0807]: a node was refused a credential: it was removed
  cause  node node3 is on the server's list of removed nodes
  fix    remove its name from the revoked file, then restart zcube-server
  more   zcube explain E0807 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0807.html
